title: mimi-server: refuse client mimi-fanout Message/set create
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 (6bcd9d8) L435: 'Only servers create such Messages; the server MUST reject a Message/set create with this body type with an invalidProperties SetError naming bodyType.' This applies in any Chat, not only room-bound ones. chat-server's ChatBackend::may_create_message (JMAP-dfo4) receives only the target Chat, not the Message, so a ChatBackend cannot enforce it with that hook. Also L425: application/mimi-fanout 'is an encrypted body type for the purposes of JMAP-CHAT'. Needs either a hook that sees the create's bodyType or a configurable server-only/encrypted body type set in chat-server. Found while implementing JMAP-6k5d.4.
